guitar.guitaristsText: Dave Murray / Adrian Smith / Janick Gers
guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (Murray & Smith signature models) / Gibson Les Paul (Gers)
guitar.evidence: Dave Murray and Adrian Smith both have Fender Stratocaster signature models; well documented for a 3-guitarist lineup.

tone.target: bright NWOBHM Marshall crunch with tight gallop bite
tone.profile: bright NWOBHM Marshall crunch with tight gallop bite
tone.summary: A high-gain, mid-forward signal chain utilizing an OD boost for attack, followed by a UK 45 amp model and UK Vintage 4x12 cab to achieve the classic NWOBHM crunch and bite.

rig.name: Iron Maiden - The Trooper - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and hum during fast gallop passages.
Provide aggressive attack and upper-mid forward crunch for the rhythm chug.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to emulate a classic British overdrive boost (like an early Tube Screamer or similar) without excessive coloration, focusing on tightening the low end and boosting mids/highs.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core high-gain rhythm tone and bite required for NWOBHM.
blocks.gap: Using the general 'Distortion' model to provide a solid, aggressive foundation without sounding like modern metal or overly fizzy.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the classic Marshall/Plexi sound required for Iron Maiden's era.
Provide the classic British rock cabinet sound and necessary punch.
Slightly boost the upper-mids and treble to enhance bite and cut through the mix.
Optional subtle thickening for lead lines (kept off for rhythm focus).
blocks.gap: Not strictly necessary for the core tone, but useful for adding dimension to leads.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic echo for lead fills without washing out the rhythm.
blocks.gap: A moderate delay is useful for adding space to the bright lead sustain, but must be kept minimal.

blocks.purpose: Provide a natural sense of space without the excessive wash of huge reverb.
blocks.gap: The 'huge reverb' avoidance suggests keeping ambience controlled, making Room preferable to Plate/Spring for this specific genre.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to enhance the tight, aggressive bite required for NWOBHM rhythm.

proposals.reason: Enhance the tight, punchy bite needed for fast gallops.
proposals.expectedGain: Tighter low end and increased upper-mid definition.
